summary: Log cabin lookout in Valley County, Idaho, recorded in 1925 and abandoned in 1946; now listed as ruins. No source describes what remains or whether the public may visit.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both describe the site as ruins; neither says what is left

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists it as hike-in; no trail route is described in the sources read

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates: the ffla pair (44.82013, -115.7892) matches Keeping Watch and was kept. The brief's idaho_fl pair (44.80462, -115.79623) did not appear on any page we read, so it was not used. The elevation is in the story only because the facts schema has no elevation key. No source states the access level or whether the public may visit, so access is omitted. The 1944 staffing is a single newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. No source describes the remains today. No photo was found.
